Installation

Docker Compose is the recommended deployment method.

Docker Compose setup

Create a directory for NGMS, save the following as docker-compose.yml, and customize the volume paths.

docker-compose.yml 
---
services:

  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER:     ngms
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: changeme
      POSTGRES_DB:       ngms
    volumes:
      - ./data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ngms"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 5

  ngms:
    image: ghcr.io/ausagentsmith-org/stackarr:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "9111:9111"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://ngms:changeme@postgres:5432/ngms
      STACKARR_PORT: 9111
      # Optional — set a fixed API key instead of generating one
      # STACKARR_API_KEY: your-api-key-here
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config             # app config and DB migrations
      - /path/to/tv:/media/tv        # root folder for series
      - /path/to/movies:/media/movies # root folder for movies
      - /path/to/downloads:/downloads # download client staging
⚠
Change the Postgres password before deploying. The default changeme is for illustration only — use a strong unique password.

Start the stack

shell 
docker compose up -d
# Wait for both containers to be healthy
docker compose ps

NGMS is now reachable at http://your-host:9111. On first access it redirects to the First Boot Wizard.

First Boot Wizard

The wizard walks you through six steps — you can complete them now or skip and configure later.

1

Admin account

Create your admin username and password. This is the first user with the Owner role — all subsequent users are created from Settings → Users.

2

Authentication method

Choose Forms auth (username + password) or External auth (reverse proxy provides a trusted X-Remote-User header). Most installs use Forms.

3

Root folders

Add the paths where NGMS should put organized series and movies. These must match the container volume mounts — e.g. /media/tv and /media/movies.

4

Download client

Choose embedded torrent, embedded usenet, or configure an external client. You can add more clients after setup from Settings → Download Clients.

5

Indexers

Add at least one indexer so NGMS can search for releases. Newznab (usenet) and Torznab (torrent) require an API URL + key from your indexer provider. Cardigann definitions require no key.

6

Done

NGMS is ready. The wizard redirects to the main UI. Add your first series or movie to verify the full pipeline works end-to-end.

Environment variables reference

VariableDefaultDescription
DATABASE_URLrequiredPostgreSQL connection string
STACKARR_PORT9111HTTP port NGMS listens on
STACKARR_API_KEYauto-generatedOverride the generated API key
STACKARR_LOG_LEVELinfoerror / warn / info / debug / trace
STACKARR_CONFIG_PATH/configDirectory for config file and migrations
STACKARR_*—All TOML config keys are settable via env var with this prefix

Updating

shell 
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
# Database migrations run automatically on startup
✦
Hard links for space efficiency. If your download staging directory and media root folders are on the same filesystem (same Docker volume mount or bind mount), NGMS uses hard links during import — effectively zero-copy. Files won't count double against disk space.
